title: Resolve the Node option-table probe with the runner's executable rules
outcome: Resolve the Node option-table probe with the runner's executable rules
acceptance: The Node option-table probe and subsequent focused stage use the same resolved executable, including the launcher's PATH-only and Windows .exe rules; metadata cache identity uses that resolved path.
A regression with distinct cwd/PATH candidates verifies consistent probe and runner selection, while supported Node and Vitest invocation behavior remains valid.
